008package paint.shared.objects;
009
010import tech.tablesaw.api.ColumnType;
011
012import java.util.ArrayList;
013import java.util.List;
014import java.util.Map;
015
016import static java.lang.Double.parseDouble;
017import static java.lang.Integer.parseInt;
018import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
019import static paint.shared.utils.BooleanUtils.isBooleanTrue;
020
021/**
022 * Represents all metadata and associated data objects for a single experiment
023 * recording in the PAINT analysis framework.
024 *
025 * <p>
026 * This class contains experiment-level descriptive metadata as well as
027 * references to the square and track objects produced during analysis.
028 * </p>
029 *
030 * <p>
031 * The schema for ExperimentInfo is embedded directly in {@link Column}, which
032 * binds human-readable CSV headers to their corresponding Tablesaw types.
033 * Table I/O classes use this enum for all schema operations.
034 * </p>
035 */
036public class ExperimentInfo {
037
038    //=========================================================================
039    //  CORE FIELDS
040    //=========================================================================
041
042    private String  experimentName;
043    private String  recordingName;
044    private int     conditionNumber;
045    private int     replicateNumber;
046    private String  probeName;
047    private String  probeType;
048    private String  cellType;
049    private String  adjuvant;
050    private double  concentration;
051    private boolean processFlag;
052    private double  threshold;
053
054    /** Associated objects for downstream analysis. */
055    private final List<Square> squares = new ArrayList<>();
056    private final List<Track>  tracks  = new ArrayList<>();
057
058    /**
059     * Default empty constructor.
060     */
061    public ExperimentInfo() {
062    }
063
064    //=========================================================================
065    //  CONSTRUCTORS
066    //=========================================================================
067
068    /**
069     * Constructs an ExperimentInfo instance from a row of key-value pairs
070     * (typically parsed from experiment_info.csv).
071     *
072     * @param row the map of header → text value
073     */
074    public ExperimentInfo(Map<String, String> row) {
075        try {
076            this.experimentName  = row.get(EXPERIMENT_NAME);
077            this.recordingName   = row.get(RECORDING_NAME);
078            this.conditionNumber = parseInt(row.get(CONDITION_NUMBER));
079            this.replicateNumber = parseInt(row.get(REPLICATE_NUMBER));
080            this.probeName       = row.get(PROBE_NAME);
081            this.probeType       = row.get(PROBE_TYPE);
082            this.cellType        = row.get(CELL_TYPE);
083            this.adjuvant        = row.get(ADJUVANT);
084            this.concentration   = parseDouble(row.get(CONCENTRATION));
085            this.processFlag     = isBooleanTrue(row.get(PROCESS_FLAG));
086            this.threshold       = parseDouble(row.get(THRESHOLD));
087        }
088        catch (Exception e) {
089            // Fail fast with context instead of leaving a half-built object that
090            // the caller would process as if valid. The single caller
091            // (RunTrackMateOnExperiment) catches this per-record and skips it.
092            throw new IllegalArgumentException("Could not parse Experiment Info row: " + row, e);
093        }
094    }
095
096    /**
097     * @return the name of the experiment.
098     */
099    public String getExperimentName() {
100        return experimentName;
101    }
102
103    //=========================================================================
104    //  ACCESSORS & MUTATORS
105    //=========================================================================
106
107    /**
108     * @param experimentName the experiment name to set.
109     */
110    public void setExperimentName(String experimentName) {
111        this.experimentName = experimentName;
112    }
113
114    /**
115     * @return the unique name of the recording.
116     */
117    public String getRecordingName() {
118        return recordingName;
119    }
120
121    /**
122     * @param recordingName the recording name to set.
123     */
124    public void setRecordingName(String recordingName) {
125        this.recordingName = recordingName;
126    }
127
128    /**
129     * @return the condition number.
130     */
131    public int getConditionNumber() {
132        return conditionNumber;
133    }
134
135    /**
136     * @param conditionNumber the condition number to set.
137     */
138    public void setConditionNumber(int conditionNumber) {
139        this.conditionNumber = conditionNumber;
140    }
141
142    /**
143     * @return the replicate number.
144     */
145    public int getReplicateNumber() {
146        return replicateNumber;
147    }
148
149    /**
150     * @param replicateNumber the replicate number to set.
151     */
152    public void setReplicateNumber(int replicateNumber) {
153        this.replicateNumber = replicateNumber;
154    }
155
156    /**
157     * @return the name of the probe.
158     */
159    public String getProbeName() {
160        return probeName;
161    }
162
163    /**
164     * @param probeName the probe name to set.
165     */
166    public void setProbeName(String probeName) {
167        this.probeName = probeName;
168    }
169
170    /**
171     * @return the type of probe.
172     */
173    public String getProbeType() {
174        return probeType;
175    }
176
177    /**
178     * @param probeType the probe type to set.
179     */
180    public void setProbeType(String probeType) {
181        this.probeType = probeType;
182    }
183
184    /**
185     * @return the cell type used.
186     */
187    public String getCellType() {
188        return cellType;
189    }
190
191    /**
192     * @param cellType the cell type to set.
193     */
194    public void setCellType(String cellType) {
195        this.cellType = cellType;
196    }
197
198    /**
199     * @return the adjuvant used.
200     */
201    public String getAdjuvant() {
202        return adjuvant;
203    }
204
205    /**
206     * @param adjuvant the adjuvant to set.
207     */
208    public void setAdjuvant(String adjuvant) {
209        this.adjuvant = adjuvant;
210    }
211
212    /**
213     * @return the probe concentration.
214     */
215    public double getConcentration() {
216        return concentration;
217    }
218
219    /**
220     * @param concentration the concentration to set.
221     */
222    public void setConcentration(double concentration) {
223        this.concentration = concentration;
224    }
225
226    /**
227     * @return true if the process flag is set.
228     */
229    public boolean isProcessFlagSet() {
230        return processFlag;
231    }
232
233    /**
234     * @param processFlag the process flag to set.
235     */
236    public void setProcessFlag(boolean processFlag) {
237        this.processFlag = processFlag;
238    }
239
240    /**
241     * @return the analysis threshold.
242     */
243    public double getThreshold() {
244        return threshold;
245    }
246
247    /**
248     * @param threshold the threshold to set.
249     */
250    public void setThreshold(double threshold) {
251        this.threshold = threshold;
252    }
253
254
255    /**
256     * Returns a human-readable summary of this ExperimentInfo, useful
257     * for diagnostic logs and console output.
258     */
259    @Override
260    public String toString() {
261
262        return "\tExperiment Info\n" +
263                String.format("\t  Experiment Name    : %s%n", experimentName) +
264                String.format("\t  Recording Name     : %s%n", recordingName) +
265                String.format("\t  Condition Nr       : %d%n", conditionNumber) +
266                String.format("\t  Replicate Nr       : %d%n", replicateNumber) +
267                String.format("\t  Probe Name         : %s%n", probeName) +
268                String.format("\t  Probe Type         : %s%n", probeType) +
269                String.format("\t  Cell Type          : %s%n", cellType) +
270                String.format("\t  Adjuvant           : %s%n", adjuvant) +
271                String.format("\t  Concentration      : %.2f%n", concentration) +
272                String.format("\t  Threshold          : %.2f%n", threshold) +
273                String.format("\t  Track Count        : %d%n", tracks.size()) +
274                String.format("\t  Square Count       : %d%n", squares.size());
275    }
276
277    //=========================================================================
278    // ENUM
279    //=========================================================================
280
281    public enum Column {
282
283        EXPERIMENT_NAME(  "Experiment Name",  ColumnType.STRING),
284        RECORDING_NAME(   "Recording Name",   ColumnType.STRING),
285        CONDITION_NUMBER( "Condition Number", ColumnType.INTEGER),
286        REPLICATE_NUMBER( "Replicate Number", ColumnType.INTEGER),
287        PROBE_NAME(       "Probe Name",       ColumnType.STRING),
288        PROBE_TYPE(       "Probe Type",       ColumnType.STRING),
289        CELL_TYPE(        "Cell Type",        ColumnType.STRING),
290        ADJUVANT(         "Adjuvant",         ColumnType.STRING),
291        CONCENTRATION(    "Concentration",    ColumnType.DOUBLE),
292        PROCESS_FLAG(     "Process Flag",     ColumnType.BOOLEAN),
293        THRESHOLD(        "Threshold",        ColumnType.DOUBLE);
294
295        /**
296         * The CSV header for this column.
297         */
298        public final String header;
299
300        /**
301         * The Tablesaw type associated with this column.
302         */
303        public final ColumnType type;
304
305        Column(String header, ColumnType type) {
306            this.header = header;
307            this.type = type;
308        }
309    }
310}
